name: Litter-Robot 4
tagline: The ultimate self-cleaning litter box — premium build, whisper-quiet, and app-connected.
description: The Litter-Robot 4 is the gold standard in automatic litter boxes. With OmniSense detection, whisper-quiet operation under 50 dB, and comprehensive health tracking via the Whisker app, it delivers the best hands-free experience for multi-cat households.
features: OmniSense detection with laser & weight sensors
Supports up to 4 cats (25 lbs each)
pros: Best-in-class odor control with sealed waste drawer
Very quiet operation — suitable for bedrooms
Excellent app with health insights and weight tracking
Premium build quality with sleek design
Accommodates large cats up to 25 lbs
cons: Proprietary waste bags recommended for best fit

name: PETKIT Pura Max
tagline: Best value automatic litter box with xSecure safety and built-in deodorizer.
description: The PETKIT Pura Max offers an impressive array of features at a more accessible price. Its xSecure 5-point safety system, N50 active deodorizer, and spacious interior make it a top choice for smart cat owners.
features: Extra-large cylinder interior (cats up to 18 lbs)
Smart app with usage stats & cycle customization
pros: Very spacious interior for larger cats
Multiple safety sensors for peace of mind
Modern design blends with home decor

name: CatLink Scooper Standard Pro
tagline: Reliable budget-friendly automatic litter box with smart health monitoring.
description: The CatLink Scooper Standard Pro proves you don't need to spend $600+ for a reliable automatic litter box. It delivers solid performance, double odor control, and health tracking at the best price in its category.
features: Double odor control with carbon filter + sealed design
Smart weight monitoring for health tracking
Affordable entry into automatic litter boxes
pros: Compact design fits in tighter spaces
Good app features for the price
cons: Not ideal for very large cats (over 15 lbs)
